scope: Engineering CAD/BIM models, model execution environments, startup releases, associated evaluation and representation research

additions.title: Introducing SGS-1
additions.method_summary: Research preview reconstructing images and meshes as B-rep STEP parts for CAD editing, with limitations on thin structures, organic surfaces, and one-shot assemblies.
additions.section: Research on AI Tools and Deployment
additions.availability: Official Hugging Face Space linked; downloadable weights not verified.
additions.limitations: STEP geometry does not establish native editable feature history; demo not executed; results vendor-reported.

additions.title: A Turing Test for Physical Engineering
additions.method_summary: Reports a CAD agent combining SGS-Mk2 with VLM orchestration and Quartz for part construction, editing, and constrained assembly tasks.
additions.section: Research on AI Tools and Deployment
additions.availability: Public technical report; public SGS-Mk2 weights not verified.
additions.limitations: CSWP passes and cost results are vendor-reported. The 45 internal QA tasks differ from live exam scoring; the report discloses answer-store exposure and says certification agents lacked file/database/shell access. No independent reproduction.

additions.title: Quartz: CAD Software Built for Machine Intelligence
additions.method_summary: Describes a proprietary CAD execution and training environment with constrained parametric parts, mates, parallel agents, and demonstrated SOLIDWORKS/NX feature-tree translation.
additions.section: Research on AI Tools and Deployment
additions.availability: Official technical introduction with contact-based access; public release not verified.
additions.limitations: Commercial geometry kernel; not open source. Throughput and interoperability are vendor demonstrations, not independently reproduced; advanced surfacing/CAM expansion is roadmap.

additions.title: ClassCAD.ai
additions.method_summary: Connects agents through MCP, scripts, skills, and rendering to a headless CAD engine with parametric history, geometric checks, and plan-dependent STEP export.
additions.availability: Public agent tooling repository; the ClassCAD engine has separate licensing and commercial-use restrictions.
additions.limitations: Inspected repository README and source tree including packages/tests; no repository-wide license detected. Free tooling does not make the CAD engine open source. No installation or execution performed.

additions.title: Motif Design: Agent-Native BIM Modeling
additions.method_summary: Embeds agents in a collaborative BIM model for parametric content generation, model editing, and documentation, with team-mediated access.
additions.availability: Separately licensed; access through the team, without a self-serve trial as of review.
additions.limitations: Capabilities are documented by the vendor, not independently exercised. Distinct from Motif Review; open-platform branding is not an open-source license.

additions.title: BIMLOGIQ Argus: CAD-to-MEP and Parametric Revit Modeling
additions.method_summary: Builds connected Revit MEP networks from DWG/DXF drawings and automates room layouts with post-generation geometry and connectivity checks.
additions.availability: Commercial Revit add-in with documented September releases and download/demo entry points.
additions.limitations: Source-level capability verification only; no network construction or code-compliance claims independently tested. MEP workflow requires a user-confirmed summary.

additions.title: Adam Parametric CAD Migrations
additions.method_summary: Rebuilds parametric history in a destination CAD system with stepwise geometric verification and model-metadata transfer, subject to source/destination assessment.
additions.availability: Commercial demo/assessment route; source/destination support is reviewed with representative models.
additions.limitations: Official page is undated; 2026 is the catalog review-year snapshot, not a verified launch date. Do not infer every feature or every system pairing is supported. Distinct migration workflow from the existing Adam generation entry.

additions.title: Shape: A Self-Supervised 3D Geometry Foundation Model for Industrial CAD Analysis
additions.method_summary: Learns dense CAD-mesh embeddings with masked geometric reconstruction, multi-resolution contrastive consistency, and per-region attribution.
additions.availability: Paper and associated Apache-2.0 code; README links pretrained weights.
additions.limitations: CAD representation/analysis model, not a text-to-CAD generator. Task-specific heads are disabled in the inspected release; reported results not independently reproduced. README, code tree, package, and repository license metadata inspected.

additions.title: BIMVLM: A vision-language model for iterative generation of component BIM models
additions.method_summary: Uses multimodal inputs and iterative modeling-action prediction to generate structured component BIM models.
additions.availability: Published paper; code and downloadable weights not verified.
additions.limitations: Direct publisher extraction returned 403; publisher-indexed metadata and abstract were inspected, not the complete paywalled paper. Results not reproduced.

additions.title: A Dual-Head Self-Reflective Framework for Text-to-CAD Generation
additions.method_summary: Separates topological tokens from numerical parameters and combines B-rep-aware constrained CadQuery decoding with symbolic repair feedback.
additions.availability: Publisher journal pre-proof; code and weights not verified.
additions.limitations: Direct publisher extraction returned 403; indexed publisher metadata, highlights and abstract inspected. No full-text or independent reproduction claim.

additions.title: Text2CSG: Generating CAD models from natural language via constructive solid geometry
additions.method_summary: Generates interpretable CSG construction trees from text using a structure-aware Transformer with hierarchical supervision and validity constraints.
additions.availability: Published paper; abstract promises code/data release, which was not verified.
additions.limitations: Publisher indexed metadata/abstract inspected after direct DOI fetch failed. Previously deferred for incomplete metadata; this pass verified authors and DOI. No code availability inferred from a promise.

additions.title: Ishigaki-IDS: An Open-Weight Verifier-Aware Model for Information Delivery Specification Drafting in Building Information Modeling
additions.method_summary: Generates BIM requirement specifications as IDS XML using domain training and external-validator rewards; the linked 8B model has gated file access.
additions.availability: Official 8B model card declares CC BY 4.0; file access requires agreement/contact sharing.
additions.limitations: Generates information requirements, not 3D geometry. Weight files were not accessed past the gate. Validator acceptance and semantic requirement fidelity are separate; results not reproduced.

additions.title: Ishigaki-IDS-Bench: A Benchmark for Generating Information Delivery Specification from BIM Information Requirements
additions.method_summary: Evaluates BIM requirement-to-IDS generation on expert-authored bilingual tasks using external schema/vocabulary audits and facet-level content fidelity.
additions.availability: Paper links a dataset DOI and evaluation-code DOI.
additions.limitations: 166 examples derived from 83 scenarios; not a 3D geometry benchmark. Asset contents were not independently downloaded or executed; acceptance verified from arXiv comments, not a claim the November conference has occurred.

additions.title: Assessing the CAD Capabilities of General-Purpose AI Models: A Case Study of GPT-6 Astra
additions.method_summary: Studies CAD understanding, generation, editing, and evaluation, documenting gaps in geometric validity, parameter dependencies, and assembly mating.
additions.availability: Public paper and author-linked project page.
additions.limitations: Empirical case study rather than evidence of manufacturing readiness; reported evaluations not independently reproduced.

updates.title: Zoo.dev Text-to-CAD:
updates.note: Update the existing 2024 text-to-CAD platform entry rather than duplicate Zookeeper. Agent implementation and CAD engine should not be conflated with open model weights. KCL 4 assembly support is future work.

updates.title: MecAgent:
updates.note: Update existing platform; V2 major release is September 30, not the October 7 patch date quoted by secondary coverage. Current documented version 2.0.6 dated October 12. Product not executed.

updates.title: IndustryForge-27B:
updates.note: Associate author-linked model card, Apache-2.0 declaration and 12 actual Safetensors shards. Paper and model card disagree on base-model name; do not resolve speculatively. Assembly and API-code limitations documented; not an end-to-end verified generator.

deferred.title: VisCAD-M1 downloadable weights
deferred.reason: Paper verified, but no author-associated model file listing verified in this pass; do not invent a model URL.

deferred.title: OpenCADStudio and general 3D mesh generators
deferred.reason: General CAD/mesh software alone does not establish the targeted learned CAD/BIM generation contribution.

deferred.title: Text2CSG code and dataset assets
deferred.reason: Official abstract promises release; actual linked assets not verified. Paper added separately.
